what: Workday makes cloud software for managing people and money: human resources, payroll, recruiting, and financial accounting and planning, used by over 11,500 organisations.
customers: Large enterprises, universities, hospitals and government bodies, mostly in North America and Europe.
moat: Systems that hold a company's entire employee and financial record, where replacing them means re-implementing payroll and accounting across the organisation.
risks: Operating margin of 8% is low because stock-based compensation is very large
Large enterprise deals are slow and can slip between quarters
Finance software adoption has been slower than HR
It pays no dividend and trades at a high multiple of profit
opportunities: Revenue grew about 13% last year with subscription revenue renewing at very high rates
The finance side is much less penetrated than HR and is the bigger long-term market
Cash roughly matches debt, with strong free cash flow
watch: Subscription revenue backlog growth and operating margin excluding stock compensation.
